name: Demo Yard
quoteBlurb: This is a demonstration build. On your install this design lands in your inbox.
_quote_comment: demo mode: the sales page is not a shed yard and has no inbox for a customer's design to land in. Posting a lead here would be collecting somebody's name and phone for a company that does not exist. The button says so and points at the demo request form on the page around it instead — target=_top, because this runs inside an iframe.

quote.notice: You are on a demonstration copy of the builder, so nothing has been sent and nobody has your details. On a real install this is the moment the design reaches the dealer — their inbox gets the building, the itemized price shown here, the customer's contact details, and a link that reopens this exact shed.
